fullDescription: A cinematic, dark-mode portfolio design featuring high-contrast orange accents, fluid mesh gradients, and grain overlays. This design is optimized for high-end creative portfolios, fintech landing pages, and personal brand sites for executives. Key features include a scroll-less, section-based navigation system, a circular clip-path menu transition, and sophisticated GSAP-powered staggered animations. It combines bold editorial typography with technical monospace details to create a 'futuristic-industrial' aesthetic. Keywords: orange, dark mode, grain, mesh gradients, GSAP, cinematic, portfolio, fintech, executive, minimalist, maximalist typography, full-screen menu.
prompt:
## Resumo
A high-end, immersive multi-section portfolio experience using fixed section transitions instead of scrolling. Features a bold orange and deep black color palette, fluid background animations, and a full-screen circular menu with project previews.

## Estilo Visual
Create a cinematic dark-themed UI using a background of #080808. Use #FF4D00 (International Orange) as the primary accent color for high-impact elements. Apply a fixed grain overlay using an SVG turbulence filter at 0.05 opacity with a 5-step infinite animation for a filmic texture. Typography: Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' (Weight 900) for large display titles (8vw to 14vw), 'Satoshi' (400, 700) for body text (1.25rem), and 'JetBrains Mono' for labels (tracking 0.5em, size 10px-12px). Include three large 'mesh blobs' in the background (#FF4D00, #B22222, #FF8C00) with 100px blur, soft-light mix-blend-mode, and a slow float animation (translateY: 30px over 15s). All interactive elements should use a custom 12px circular cursor that scales 6x and switches to white with mix-blend-mode: difference on hover. Transition curves should follow cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Page Loader
Full-screen #080808 overlay. Center a large Cabinet Grotesk percentage counter (00-100). Behind the numbers, place a glowing orb (256px) with a gradient from #FF4D00 to #B22222, set to pulse (scale 1 to 1.5) with a 40px-60px blur. Below, add a 'JetBrains Mono' status message with 0.5em letter spacing.

### Fixed Header
Fixed top bar with 2rem-3rem padding. Left side: 'AV.' logo in Cabinet Grotesk 900. Right side: Menu button consisting of a text label ('MENU' in mono) and a 40px circular button with 10% white opacity, backdrop-blur-xl, and a 'lucide:menu' icon. Hover state changes button background and border to #FF4D00.

### Hero Section
Full-screen container. Top-left: Small mono tag in #FF4D00. Center-left: Massive 14vw Cabinet Grotesk text. One line solid white, second line italicized with a 1px white outline and transparent fill. Include a large, soft-light mesh blob behind the outline text for depth. Footer of section: 1.5rem Satoshi text max-width 28rem.

### About Section
Two-column grid layout. Left side: Large display heading 'CEO of [Brand]' with italicized outline text. Body text in Satoshi with 1.75 line height. Below, a row of three stats (e.g., '10+ Years') using bold display fonts and tiny mono labels. Right side: Aspect-ratio 4:5 image container with 2rem rounded corners, grayscale image that transitions to color on hover, and a #FF4D00 glow behind the bottom-right corner.

### Work/Projects Grid
Display section title in 9vw Cabinet Grotesk. Layout: 2-column grid of aspect-video cards. Cards feature 1.5rem rounded corners, 10% white borders, and an image overlay that appears on hover. Hover overlay: 40% black tint, showing title in display font and category in mono #FF4D00.

### Contact & Footer
Centered layout. Hero-sized 'Let's Build' text with 1px outline that fills with #FF4D00 on hover. Below, three 64px circular social icons with 10% white borders that invert to white background/black icon on hover. Final footer line: 10px mono text with 0.3em letter spacing.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Circular Navigation Overlay — A full-screen navigation menu that expands as a circle from the top-right corner.
Implement a full-screen #080808 overlay with a clip-path: circle(0% at 95% 5%). On open, expand to circle(150%). Menu links should be 8vw Cabinet Grotesk, 1px white outline, turning solid #FF4D00 and translating X+20px on hover. Adjacent to each link, a 300x400px project preview image should appear at 80% opacity when the link is hovered.

### Section Progress Indicator — Minimalist fixed UI indicating current section number.
Fixed at bottom-left: '0X' in #FF4D00 mono font, followed by a 48px horizontal zinc-800 line, followed by the total section count (e.g., '04') in zinc-600 mono font.

### Magnetic Mesh Blobs — Background elements that react to mouse position.
Create three absolute-positioned div elements with 100px blur and 20-30% opacity. Use GSAP to move them relative to the mouse cursor: (e.clientX / window.innerWidth - 0.5) * 40. Apply different multipliers (0.5x, 1x, 1.5x) to each blob to create a parallax depth effect.

style.description: The style is 'Cinematic Maximalism' characterized by a deep #080808 background, vibrant #FF4D00 accents, and grain textures. Typography pairs the heavy-weight Cabinet Grotesk for headings with the clean Satoshi for body and JetBrains Mono for system-level data. Micro-interactions include a magnetic custom cursor and mesh blobs that react to mouse movement.
